The Doctor Agent failed to reconcile the conflicting data (X-ray vs. HRCT) and instead jumped to a diagnosis of exclusion (Psychogenic Dyspnea) which is clinically inappropriate given the objective finding of a restrictive pattern on PFTs and the initial X-ray findings. The agent stopped gathering necessary evidence due to the patient's constraint.

The diagnosis was unsupported by the evidence (which actually pointed towards ILD despite the normal HRCT, or at least required further investigation like biopsy or specialist referral, not a psychogenic label).
